description: Follow Jim Bakker, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Jim Bakker, who co-founded "The PTL Club" but fell into disgrace, dies at 86
changes.summary: Jim Bakker, who along with his first wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around "The PTL Club" TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes, has died at 86.

changes.title: Jim Bakker, who built 'PTL Club' televangelism empire, has died at 86
changes.summary: Jim Bakker, along with his first wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around the hugely successful "The PTL Club" TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes. (Image credit: Lou Krasky).

changes.title: Jim Bakker, minister who built a televangelism empire and lost it from sex and money scandals, dies at 86
changes.summary: "The PTL Club," which at its peak in the mid-1980s drew 13 million nightly TV viewers, made Jim and Tammy Faye Bakker cultural icons — so much so that they were often skewered in the 1980s and 90s by late-night comedians and parodied on "Saturday Night Live.".

changes.title: Jim Bakker, Television Preacher Felled by Sex and Financial Scandals, Dies at 86
changes.summary: With his wife, Tammy Faye, Mr. Bakker built a broadcasting juggernaut around the gospel of prosperity.
